setup.location: Samaritan Hospital System (fictional alternate-universe Watertown), Ward That Remembers

beats.speaker: Zip
beats.text: Don't sign a thing. And check the dates. They overlap.

beats.speaker: Nell Mercer
beats.action: examines discharge record without touching the form
beats.text: My first discharge was forty years after my second. So how did I sign both yesterday?

beats.speaker: Raven
beats.text: That is the first sensible question anyone has asked in this ward. If you insist on an answer, you'll have to find a record the hospital didn't write.

beats.speaker: Erin
beats.action: freezes the proposed replay, opens read-only audit record
beats.text: No timeline rerun. No consent inferred from a future self. This is an audit, Nell. You can stop it at any moment.

beats.speaker: Lari
beats.action: tests player with a false binary choice
beats.text: Two doors, darling: sign the discharge or spend another life here. I always did enjoy an efficient menu.

beats.speaker: Zip
beats.action: uncovers a hidden third option underneath the form
beats.text: Three doors. The little one says CHALLENGE THE CONTRACT. They left it out of the brochure.

beats.speaker: Raven
beats.action: accepts the evidence challenge and leaves the decision to Nell
beats.text: Then you've found the first crack in the system. The next move is yours.

clues: future signatures are not present consent

nextChoices.label: Ask Erin to explain the continuity record
